title: coxswain.quota.v1
description: One quota headroom projection for a (harness, model). The only quota type routing, the watcher, cox state, and the board read. Persisted (projection only) in <workspace>/cox/.cache/quota.json.

model.description: window family (fable, opus, ...) or empty for the account-wide scope

known.description: false whenever the value is not machine-readable; other value fields are meaningful only when true

percent_remaining.description: effective percent remaining across the bounding windows

resets_at.description: RFC 3339 reset of the binding window

usable_runway_seconds.description: seconds of usable runway for a finite result; -1 when the source states none (through_reset, unknown, or a schema without the field)

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 time the projection was read

reason.description: why unknown (empty when known), or a health note

window_ids.description: the bounding window set the reading was computed from
